evidence_sentence: If any decoding or memory allocation fails, it handles errors appropriately and cleans up allocated resources before returning the error code.
rationale: The fixed implementation dynamically allocates decryption and ticket buffers, explicitly handles a kmalloc failure, and frees ticket_buf and dbuf on exit. The vulnerable implementation instead uses pre-existing fixed-size buffers and contains neither the allocation-failure branch nor cleanup of dynamically allocated buffers. This sentence therefore describes fixed-only resource-management behavior.
rewritten_docstring: The function decodes the ticket type and structure version, retrieves the appropriate ticket handler, and decrypts the ticket data. It updates the session key and ticket blob based on the validity and expiration information. If decoding fails, it handles the error appropriately before returning the error code.
